name: retcalc-marketing
description: Builds the RetCalc marketing package, the two one-pagers and the two decks. See ../README.md.

scripts.setup: npm ci && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt
scripts.capture: rm -f ../.preview/capture/texts-*.jsonl && node shoot2.mjs && node recap.mjs && node guide.mjs && node rp.mjs && node plan.mjs && node story.mjs && node signin.mjs && node logo.mjs && THEME=dark node shoot2.mjs && THEME=dark node recap.mjs && THEME=dark node guide.mjs && THEME=dark node rp.mjs && THEME=dark node plan.mjs && THEME=dark node story.mjs && THEME=dark node signin.mjs && python3 captures.py
scripts.pdf: node ../build/build.mjs && node render.mjs ../build/package.html ../RetCalc-Marketing-Package.pdf ../.preview/pdf && node render.mjs ../build/onepager.html ../RetCalc-One-Pager.pdf ../.preview/onepager && node ../build/build-dash-onepager.mjs && node render.mjs ../build/dash-onepager.html ../RetCalc-Dashboard-One-Pager.pdf ../.preview/dashone && .venv/bin/python outline.py ../RetCalc-Marketing-Package.pdf ../build/outline.json
scripts.measure: node measure.mjs ../build/package.html && node measure.mjs ../build/onepager.html && node measure.mjs ../build/dash-onepager.html
scripts.deck:check: mkdir -p ../.preview && cp ../RetCalc-Deck.pptx ../.preview/deck.pptx && osascript ppt2pdf.applescript "$PWD/../.preview/deck.pptx" "$PWD/../.preview/deck.pdf" && .venv/bin/python pdf2png.py ../.preview/deck.pdf ../.preview/deck 1.6 && cp ../RetCalc-Dashboard-Deck.pptx ../.preview/dash-deck.pptx && osascript ppt2pdf.applescript "$PWD/../.preview/dash-deck.pptx" "$PWD/../.preview/dash-deck.pdf" && .venv/bin/python pdf2png.py ../.preview/dash-deck.pdf ../.preview/dash-deck 1.6
scripts.capture:dash: node dash.mjs light desk,phone,landing,setup,report && node dash.mjs dark desk,phone,landing,setup && node pdfdash-extra.mjs && node dashone-extra.mjs && node dashdeck-extra.mjs
